title: Half-node failure-bit bound
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $b$, let $T_0=1$ and $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$, and let $\delta=1/2^{b+1}$. The number of failure bits associated with the parameter $\delta/(2T_k)$ is at most $\bigl(\lceil\log_2 T_k\rceil+2(\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor+1)+5\bigr)(b+1)$, where the number of failure bits for a positive parameter $q$ is $\lceil\log_2\lceil 2/q\rceil\rceil$.
